install.allSetBody: The {} app is installed on this device.
install.androidMenuFallback: Chrome has not offered an install prompt yet. Tap the menu [⋮] and choose [Install app] to add it to your home screen.
install.androidStep1Body: If you're not already, open this page in Chrome on your Android device.
install.androidStep2Body: Chrome will add the app to your home screen in one tap.
install.androidStep3Body: Launch the app from your home screen any time — just like any other app.
install.androidSubtitle: Chrome will add the app to your home screen in one tap.
install.desktopStep2: Point it at the QR code — tap the notification
install.desktopStep3: Follow the install instructions on your phone
install.desktopSubtitle: Scan the QR code with your phone camera — you'll land right back on this page to install.
install.heroBody: Add the {} app to your home screen for fast, full-screen access to sermons, events, giving, and community — wherever the week takes you.
install.iosNote: Using Chrome or another browser on iPhone? Apple requires Safari to install web apps. There is no one-tap install button — the steps above are the Apple way.
install.iosStep1Body: iPhone installs only work in Safari. If you're in Chrome, tap the share icon and choose [Open in Safari].
install.iosStep2Body: Find the share icon at the bottom of Safari — the square with the upward arrow.
install.iosStep3Body: Scroll down, tap [Add to Home Screen], then [Add]. Done!
install.iosSubtitle: Safari is required — just three taps and you're in.
install.lede: تُفتح العظات والمجموعات والخدمة والعطاء كتطبيق، مع الإشعارات. لا حاجة للتنزيل من متجر التطبيقات.
